Great idea. I’ve drafted ready-to-use screening criteria and a simple scoring rubric for the most common IT roles. Once Chen confirms specifics, I’ll tailor these and move straight into screening.

Cross-role defaults
- Seniority bands:
  - Junior: 0–2 years
  - Mid: 3–5 years
  - Senior: 6–9 years
  - Staff/Principal: 10+ years, architecture/ownership scope
- General must-haves: solid communication, version control (git), testing mindset, CI/CD familiarity, cloud literacy (AWS/Azure/GCP), basic security best practices, measurable impact in prior roles.
- Red flags: no concrete outcomes, unclear role scope, excessive job-hopping without rationale, weak fundamentals, no evidence of collaboration, obvious resume keyword stuffing.
- Certifications (nice-to-have unless specified): AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security (Sec+, CISSP/OSCP for Security), Microsoft (MCSA), networking (CCNA), data (GCP Data Engineer/Databricks).

Role-specific criteria

1) Backend Software Engineer
- Must-have: 3–5+ years (mid/senior), one primary language (Java, Python, Node.js, Go), REST APIs, SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL), ORM familiarity, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, containerization basics (Docker), cloud basics.
- Nice-to-have: microservices, gRPC, messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), caching (Redis), observability, Kubernetes, performance tuning, security (OAuth2/JWT).
- Quick screen questions: most impactful service built; scale handled; testing approach; production incident experience.

2) Frontend Engineer
- Must-have: 3–5+ years, React/Vue/Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, semantic HTML/CSS, state management (Redux/Pinia/Vuex/Zustand), API integration (REST/GraphQL), component testing (Jest/RTL/Vitest).
- Nice-to-have: SSR (Next.js/Nuxt), design systems, accessibility, perf optimization, end-to-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), build tooling (Vite/Webpack).
- Quick screen: recent complex UI; performance debugging; accessibility approach.

3) Full-Stack Engineer
- Must-have: Proficient in one frontend framework and one backend stack, databases (SQL), API design, end-to-end testing basics, CI/CD.
- Nice-to-have: cloud deployment, infra as code basics, ownership of features across stack.
- Quick screen: feature delivered end-to-end; tradeoffs made.

4) DevOps/SRE
- Must-have: Linux, scripting (Bash/Python), CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab/Jenkins), IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, monitoring/logging (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK), cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), networking basics.
- Nice-to-have: Helm, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), security scanning, cost optimization, on-call experience.
- Certifications: CKA/CKAD, AWS SysOps/DevOps Pro.
